title: Waystones issue #1203: Boat with passenger desyncs after waystone teleport — driver can't see the boat

text:
[issue by SukenFuyumi]
### Minecraft Version

1.21.1

### Mod Loader

Fabric (Loader 0.19.3)

### Mod Version

21.1.36+fabric-1.21.1 (Balm 21.0.62)

### Describe the Issue

On a dedicated multiplayer server, two players riding the **same vanilla boat** teleport via a waystone. Both players are teleported correctly, but the boat desyncs: the **driver** (the one who activated the waystone) no longer sees the boat, while the **passenger** still sees it. Appears to be the same client-side entity desync as #402 / #718 (entity teleports but fails to render on one client).

**Reproduction:**
1. Player A (driver) + Player B (passenger) in one vanilla boat.
2. Player A activates a waystone and teleports.
3. Both arrive; Player A's client no longer renders the boat, Player B still sees it.

Consistent. No crash — purely a visual/entity desync, nothing logged.

### Performance/other mods

Yes — this is a large Cobblemon modpack (Cobbleverse) including Sodium, Lithium, C2ME, EntityCulling and ModernFix, so a client render/culling interaction can't be fully ruled out.

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
This seems to actually apply to all entities that are teleported (except items and players). If the other player in the faraway target area doesn't have the entities tracked, they're going to be invisible, even when teleporting them through Vanilla means (e.g. `/tp @e[type=donkey] @s`). So it appears to be a Vanilla bug.

I will see if I can find a workaround.
